a16z-hilbert:ashbyhq:23239c05-b19a-4ab3-.description: Hilbert is a scalable, data science-first growth engine that gives B2C teams predictive clarity into user behavior, revenue drivers, and the actions that drive sustainable growth. Fully agentic by design, Hilbert shrinks months-long decision cycles to minutes. From Fortune 10 enterprises to beloved brands like FreshDirect, Blank Street, and Levain Bakery, operators run their growth on Hilbert. We're also co-building alongside leading AI companies. Grocery, QSR & Retail is where Hilbert meets some of its highest-frequency, highest-stakes customers — businesses where a single point of retention or basket size compounds into millions, and where decisions move on a daily rhythm, not a quarterly one. We are building the team that owns this surface, and we are hiring the early operators who will grow inside it. This is not a support role. It is a learning-by-doing role with consequence. You will be in the data, in the customer's problem, and in the room when decisions get made. You default to testing, measuring, and updating your priors. - You can describe a project failure with the same precision as a win.
